decision.action: Develop a prospectively specified, non-economic cross-sectional rank-persistence screen across the 41 current structural representatives.
decision.rationale: This mechanism differs from the most recent single-symbol trend and reversion screens and can test broad cross-asset structure with existing data. Session overlap and dependence must be handled prospectively so breadth does not overstate independent evidence.

scope.data: Accepted 13-week M5 history already available for all current representatives.
scope.design: Evaluate whether cross-sectional ranks of synchronized, session-eligible returns persist over a predeclared forward horizon. Specify synchronization, session eligibility, minimum independent observations, statistic, and multiplicity correction before evaluation.
scope.interpretation: Structural evidence only; no economic outcome, winner selection, or economic promotion. Do not reuse or rerun a consumed identity.
scope.universe: Complete current eligible frontier; use the 41 current structural representatives as representatives, not as economic equivalents.

next_research_state.implementation_scope: Add the missing repository machinery to freeze and evaluate the specified non-economic screen using accepted M5 data. Enforce session synchronization, predeclared horizon/statistic/multiplicity, dependence-aware evidence, and structural-only reporting; do not open economic outcomes.

objective.goal: Select a fresh cross-sectional ranking hypothesis for the current eligible broker-native frontier.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The latest frozen trend-momentum and mean-reversion screens supported no symbols. A synchronized cross-sectional ranking screen tests a distinct, multi-asset mechanism against the full current structural breadth, using accepted 13-week M5 data rather than an old candidate or outcome-exposed evidence.

provider_meta.model_identity_limitation: Copilot CLI silent programmatic mode does not expose the model selected behind Auto.
